###########################
Results for the GCE spectrum derived in https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22913 .
In order to obtain the SED flux in figure 4 you have to do
dnde*1e-3/solidangle, where solidangle is defined below for each analysis setup. 
In this way the units are [GeV/cm^2/s/sr]
When using these results cite the aforementioned paper.
###########################
